raw_response: {"diagnosis":"On 2026-01-17 the source began sending reversals as separate REVERSAL rows (with orig_txn_id) and stopped updating the original, which now stays POSTED. The silver filter `status='POSTED'` therefore keeps reversed originals, so gold totals are too high for the most recent days.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions rv WHERE rv.status = 'REVERSAL' AND rv.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND rv.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
